correctness.rationale: For any nonsingular real 2x2 T with singular values a>=b>0, three iid uniform input angles yield a uniform common chord phase independent of triangular half-angle gap δ with density 2(pi-δ)/pi². The transformed Euclidean angle dot product equals (a²+b²)/2[cosδ+k cos(2phi+δ)], k=(a²-b²)/(a²+b²). Integrating its piecewise obtuseness probability yields P_acute=1/4-6/pi³ ∫_0^(pi/2)asin²(k sin u)du; the positive arcsine-square series and beta integral reduce it to 1/4-(3/(2pi²))Li_2(k²). Correct near-circle loss 3s²/(2pi²) with s=log(a/b), and thin limit 6t²/pi²[1-log(4t²)]+O(t⁴|log t|) with t=b/a. Independently evaluated quadrature versus Li2 at ratios 1,1.1,2,10,100 using 46-digit mpmath with disagreement <=5.5e-48; analytic proof covers all finite ratios, numerical test does not.
